copy_lines_between_files: copy lines 10-15 from source file and insert before line 5 in destination file
cut_lines_between_files: cut lines 10-15 from source file and paste them before line 5 in destination file
duplicate_lines_within_file: duplicate lines 2-3 within the same file by copying and appending at the end
move_lines_within_file: move lines 4-5 up to before line 2 within the same file using cut paste
test_file_copy_cut_paste: test the file_copy_paste and file_cut_paste tools for edge cases like invalid ranges and missing files
